verdict.rationale: Reusable sub-workflows are a fair axis for a workflow-automation product like Zapier, but the evidence pack never documents Zaps calling other Zaps or reusable workflow modules. Stored actions (reusable single action calls by id) and MCP tool bundles (shareable tool lists) are adjacent features, not sub-workflows that other workflows invoke, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can compose reusable sub-workflows or modules that other workflows call
